about: HELD-OUT test set: documents never used while building or tuning Underline. Questions were written by reading the documents, before any model was run. Same format as questions.json.

digit.source: Go Digit, Digit Supreme Care Policy wordings (UIN GODHLGP24055V012324), https://www.godigit.com/content/dam/godigit/directportal/en/downloads/health/policy-wordings-digit-supreme-care-policy.pdf (99 pages)

nitt.source: NIT Tiruchirappalli, General Guidelines for Leave (2019), https://www.nitt.edu/home/administration/rules/Leave-Rules.pdf

questions.question: What is the daily limit for room rent?
questions.expected: 1% of the Sum Insured per day.

questions.question: How much is paid per day for ICU?
questions.expected: Up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day.

questions.question: What is the maximum amount paid for cataract surgery per eye?
questions.expected: 20% of the Sum Insured, maximum Rs. 50,000 per eye.

questions.question: How many days of expenses before hospitalisation are covered?
How much hospital cash is paid for each day in hospital?
questions.expected: 0.1% of the Sum Insured per day (for Sum Insured of Rs. 3 lakh or more), up to 1% per illness.

questions.question: What is the maximum reimbursement for a health check-up?
questions.expected: Rs. 5,000 or 1% of average Sum Insured of the last three years, whichever is less; once every three claim-free years.

questions.question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases?
Is treatment for diabetes covered from the first day of the policy?
questions.expected: No. Diabetes has a 90-day waiting period.

questions.question: How long do I have to wait before a hernia operation is covered?
How long is the free look period?
questions.expected: Fifteen days from receipt of the policy.

questions.question: How much does the sum insured go up for each claim-free year?
questions.expected: 25% per claim-free year, up to a maximum of 50%.

questions.question: What discount do I get if I choose the 20% voluntary co-pay?
How long is the waiting period for the maternity cover?
questions.expected: 36 months from the date of opting the cover.

questions.question: Within how many days must I send the documents for post-hospitalisation expenses?
questions.expected: Within 15 days after the treatment is completed.

questions.question: Is there a premium discount for non-smokers?
Does the policy include a free second medical opinion?
Are telemedicine or video consultations covered?
How much does the policy pay for a road ambulance?
questions.expected: Up to Rs. 750 per hospitalisation and Rs. 1,500 per policy period.

questions.question: What is the limit for air ambulance?
questions.expected: Up to 10% of the Sum Insured per policy period.

questions.question: For how many days before admission are medical expenses covered?
For how many days after discharge are medical expenses covered?
What is the limit for organ donor expenses?
questions.expected: 10% of the Sum Insured or Rs. 1 lakh, whichever is less.

questions.question: How much is paid for a health check-up?
questions.expected: Up to Rs. 3,500 for every claim-free year.

questions.question: Is there a co-payment for people who join at age 61 or above?
questions.expected: Yes, 20% of each and every claim.

questions.question: How long is the grace period for renewing the policy?
What cumulative bonus do I get in the second year if I make no claim?
questions.expected: 25% of the expiring Sum Insured (then 10% for later years, up to 100%).

questions.question: How many times can the sum insured be automatically restored in a policy year?
What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases?
Within how many days must I file a reimbursement claim?
How much is paid for a family member's travel to visit me in hospital?
questions.expected: Compassionate travel: up to Rs. 5,000 for air travel of one immediate family member.

questions.question: Is there a premium discount for non-smokers?
Will the policy pay my home loan EMI while I am in hospital?
Is there an initial waiting period under the loss of employment cover?
questions.expected: Yes, if the event happens within 90 days of the first policy, no claim is payable.

questions.question: How much of the organ donor's pre and post hospitalisation expenses are paid?
questions.expected: Up to 5% of the claim amount.

questions.question: How many children does the maternity benefit cover?
What is the waiting period for infertility treatment?
What is the co-payment on the OPD benefit in the first year?
questions.expected: 25% in the first year (Basis 1), 10% on first renewal, then nil.

questions.question: How much of the sum insured is refilled under the refill benefit?
For home hospitalisation, how long must the illness continue?
What is the minimum age for bariatric surgery to be covered?
What is the moratorium period?
How many months is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases?
questions.expected: It is the number of months you opted, as specified in the Policy Schedule (not fixed in this document).

questions.question: What is the grace period if I pay the premium monthly?
questions.expected: Fifteen days for monthly mode (thirty days in other cases).

questions.question: Within how many days of an accident must a miscarriage happen to be covered?
Is there a premium discount for non-smokers?
Does the policy reimburse a gym membership?
How much is paid if the insured dies in an accident?
questions.expected: 100% of the sum insured, if death happens within 12 months of the accident.

questions.question: How early must I tell the insurer about a planned hospitalisation for cashless treatment?
questions.expected: At least 72 hours before (within 24 hours in an emergency).

questions.question: Within how many hours of admission must I inform the insurer for a reimbursement claim?
Within how many days of cashless approval must the treatment happen?
questions.expected: Within 15 days of approval (or before the policy expires).

questions.question: Above what claim amount are KYC documents needed?
questions.expected: When the payout exceeds Rs. 1 lakh per claim.

questions.question: What interest do I get if my claim is settled late?
Under loss of employment cover, what share of take-home salary can be paid?
questions.expected: 70% of take-home salary (or a fixed/EMI-based payout).

questions.question: Within how long after the incident is trauma counselling covered?
questions.expected: Within six months of the incident.

questions.question: For the coma benefit, how long must the person not respond to stimuli?
Are spectacles and hearing aids covered?
questions.expected: No, they are listed under specific exclusions.

questions.question: What is the yearly premium for this policy?
Does the policy cover damage to my car?
Is there a cashback if I don't make any claim?
questions.expected: Not in the document (no-claim details are fetched from the policy schedule).

questions.question: What is the maximum rental bond the landlord can ask for?
How much rent can the landlord ask me to pay in advance?
questions.expected: Not more than 2 weeks rent in advance.

questions.question: If the bond is paid to the landlord, within how long must it be deposited?
How much notice must the landlord give before increasing the rent?
How often can the rent be increased?
questions.expected: Not more than once in any 12-month period.

questions.question: If I pay for urgent repairs myself, how much can I get back?
How much notice must the landlord give before an inspection?
How many inspections are allowed in a year?
questions.expected: No more than 4 inspections in any 12 months.

questions.question: How quickly must the landlord repair a smoke alarm that is not working?
questions.expected: Within 2 business days of becoming aware.

questions.question: Is a gas leak an urgent repair?
questions.expected: Yes, a gas leak is listed as an urgent repair.

questions.question: How long does the landlord have to answer my request to keep a pet?
questions.expected: 21 days (otherwise consent is taken as given).

questions.question: How much stamp duty do I pay on this agreement?
Who pays for the internet connection?
Who pays for servicing the air conditioner?
Within how many days must the landlord give the tenant a copy of the agreement?
questions.expected: Within 14 days of the tenant signing.

questions.question: Within how long must the landlord lodge the bond?
questions.expected: Within 10 business days after receiving it (with the RTBA).

questions.question: What should I do if I don't get a bond receipt?
questions.expected: If no receipt within 15 business days, call the RTBA on 1300 13 71 64.

questions.question: Can the tenant sub-let the flat?
questions.expected: Only with the landlord's written consent, which must not be unreasonably withheld.

questions.question: Can the landlord charge a fee for agreeing to a sub-let?
questions.expected: No, except costs of preparing a written assignment.

questions.question: Who must keep the place clean during the tenancy?
Am I allowed to keep a pet?
How much notice do I need to give to end the tenancy?
questions.expected: Not in the document (it only refers to the Residential Tenancies Act 1997).

questions.question: Who pays the water bill?
How many days of casual leave do employees get in a year?
What is the most casual leave I can take at one time?
questions.expected: Normally not more than 5 days at a time.

questions.question: How much earned leave is credited each half-year?
Up to how many days of earned leave can be accumulated?
What is the maximum earned leave that can be taken at a time?
questions.expected: 180 days (300 days as leave preparatory to retirement).

questions.question: How many days of earned leave can be encashed with LTC?
questions.expected: Up to 10 days each time, maximum 60 days in the whole service.

questions.question: How long is the vacation for teaching staff?
How many days of half pay leave are given each year?
questions.expected: 20 days (10 days on 1 January and 1 July).

questions.question: How long is maternity leave?
How long is paternity leave?
How long is adoption leave?
questions.expected: 180 days, for adopting a child below one year.

questions.question: Within how many days must I apply to convert one kind of leave into another?
questions.expected: Within 30 days of completing that leave.

questions.question: After how long of continuous absence is an employee treated as having resigned?
questions.expected: Continuous absence of more than 5 years.

questions.question: Is there special leave for my own marriage?
How many work-from-home days are allowed per month?
How many days of earned leave do staff get in a year?
questions.expected: 30 days per calendar year (15 days credited on 1 January and 1 July).

questions.question: How many days of casual leave are allowed in a year?
What is the maximum study leave in the whole service?
How many days of child care leave can be taken in the whole service?
What salary is paid during child care leave?
questions.expected: 100% for the first 365 days and 80% for the next 365 days.

questions.question: Up to what age of the child can child care leave be taken?
questions.expected: Not if the child is 18 or older.

questions.question: What is the shortest child care leave I can take at a time?
questions.expected: Not less than 5 days at a time.

questions.question: How long is paternity leave?
questions.expected: 15 days (for male staff with up to two children).

questions.question: How many days of special casual leave are given for a vasectomy?
What is the maximum leave not due in the whole service?
How much leave can an aggrieved female staff member get during an inquiry?
Is there bereavement leave when a family member dies?
Is there menstrual leave for women?
Is there a discount for buying the policy online?
Is there a loyalty discount for renewing many years in a row?
